edits.old: COLLSCAN profiler entries can identify missing indexes in update/upsert paths, not only read queries. (high confidence)
edits.new: COLLSCAN profiler entries (planSummary "COLLSCAN") can point to missing indexes. The DocumentDB profiler covers update and findAndModify as well as read operations, so update operations can be inspected the same way. edits.rationale: The Pabis post shows a docdb4.0 parameter group created with Terraform, a 50 ms threshold and 1.0 sampling, chosen because traffic is low. The AWS DocumentDB profiling page recommends starting high (for example 500 ms) and lowering gradually. It also warns that 50 ms can cause performance issues for high-throughput applications. The cited source covers only the first half, so the AWS page is needed as a second source.
